product_benchmark: deterministic synthetic hidden-truth product runtime benchmark; train demonstrations -> validation demonstrations -> untouched future evaluation across multiple seeds
product_benchmark_current_vs_fixed: needed-light within 2pp and fewer premature-OFF/chatter/corrections, but false-ON time is worse (178.0s mean vs 156.33s); improvement criterion therefore fails
product_benchmark_full_ridge: Shadow-only challenger is unstable across seeds and is not deployed; production default remains unchanged
product_benchmark_evidence_semantics: historical demonstration, contextual-bandit reward, presence forecast, explicit correction, TrialRecord experiment, Shadow proxy and physical outcome are distinct evidence types and are not relabelled into one another
product_benchmark_physical_scope: synthetic lamp/lux coupling only; no claim of real Home Assistant hardware performance; host timings are not Raspberry Pi measurements
vacuum_policy: cleaning=start; idle=return_to_base/stop fallback; capability-gated; physical experiments blocked
generation_workflow: Live generation -> immutable direct child Candidate -> offline regression gate -> observed-only Shadow -> direct-parent future comparison -> optional next-generation Correct/Autonomous/Explore/Change decision -> explicit atomic Promote
generation_workflow_acceptance: G0 -> Correct -> Candidate Gen 1 -> targeted sensor Explore -> Candidate Gen 2 -> Promote -> promoted Candidate becomes Live -> next Candidate cycle starts at visible Gen 1
generation_identity: each retained generation has a stable generation_id and monotonic internal generation_number; Promote transfers the promoted Candidate generation_id to Live and freezes the previous Live generation as historical lineage
generation_parenting: every child starts from the exact retained direct-parent model snapshot and comparisons are only direct-parent versus direct-child
generation_feedback: Correct and Change decision create or coalesce only the exact same-parent child edge; feedback never crosses generation-parent boundaries
generation_restart: lineage, observed generation decisions, paired comparison state, discard intent, promotion backup and automation ownership are persisted across restart
candidate_display_generation: Candidate names contain exactly one generated Candidate suffix; visible Candidate Gen is relative to the currently active Live generation and restarts at Gen 1 after each Promote while internal lineage generations remain monotonic for audit
candidate_details_ui: Candidate Details open state and promotion-rule form state persist across polling refresh; decision tiles are synchronously rehydrated and use a dedicated 250 ms lightweight Current/Desired stream while full Candidate metrics stay on the slower status refresh.
candidate_future_evidence: offline-blocked lineage leaves continue passive observed-only A/B collection; the active direct-parent leaf is resolved by root_agent_id and highest internal generation_number, including later descendants
candidate_future_evidence_restore: passive blocked-Candidate observation no longer rewrites persisted lifecycle state; future A/B summaries are stored while offline_blocked or insufficient_evidence remains stable
candidate_custom_promotion: the single user-facing Promote action asks for confirmation; default explicit confirmation accepts currently available evidence including an offline-gate override, optional Promotion rules may tighten evidence requirements, and hard model/config/atomic/Control qualification guards remain mandatory
candidate_correct_balance: binary Correct treats user labels as error sampling; one-sided desired labels are balanced with nearest correctly-predicted positive historical anchors from the opposite class
candidate_correct_update_budget: up to three balanced rounds, then up to twelve bounded desired-arm-only hard repair rounds for unresolved explicit corrections; rejected-action negative update remains one-time
candidate_correct_balance_gate: explicit marked corrections are hard fit targets; opposite-class anchors are soft regularization/evidence; missing opposite-class anchors remains insufficient evidence; held-out per-class/global regression and one-class-collapse remain authoritative
manual_feedback: Correct is historical supervised correction on observed Desired; Change decision is immediate contextual feedback; both evolve a child generation instead of training the parent in place.
manual_feedback_ui: Live and Candidate cards expose Autonomous, Correct, Explore, Change decision and Settings; Candidate lifecycle exposes one Promote and Discard separately.
manual_feedback_context: Change decision records full-context feedback. Candidate Change decision changes only Candidate Shadow behavior and never dispatches physical control.
manual_feedback_schema: Correct preserves the direct-parent schema. Autonomous and Explore may evolve schema only in a child generation with auditable model/schema revisions.
manual_feedback_safety: Candidate inference is observed-only and never enters ActionIntent/Executor physical dispatch before Promote.
cold_start_workflow_ui: fresh waiting agents expose Train and Settings without calling generation endpoints that require a model; model-ready actions appear after training and follow lifecycle transitions on the same card
desired_teaching: Historical Correct points use persistent observed runtime Desired; missing or stale observations remain gaps and are never filled by policy replay.
agent_rendering: event-time renderer dispatch; stable card ownership by normalized agent ID; Candidate generations use distinct secondary cards preserved across Live-card reconciliation
button_teaching: Correct uses exact-generation observed history and class-balanced conservative snapshot fine-tuning; Change decision uses contextual teaching; all learning proceeds through child generations.
live_ui: Current and Desired retain the 250 ms lightweight runtime path; legacy confidence numbers are displayed as Decision strength (not a calibrated probability), while held-out policy quality and independent future evaluation are presented separately.
confidence_semantics: presence_probability, forecast_uncertainty, expected_action_utility, data_coverage, empirical_policy_quality, preference_alignment and decision_strength are distinct runtime quantities; only explicitly calibrated probability fields are probabilities
confidence_probability_calibration: independent future labels only; duplicate episode ids and training/model-derived labels do not add evidence; Brier score and 10-bin reliability are reported with dependency-aware decay/effective_n
confidence_action_quality: future episode error/cost with Wilson-style uncertainty intervals and dependency-aware effective_n; ON and OFF evidence remain separate
confidence_optional_stopping: challenger selection evidence freezes first; a later fixed-size future evaluation is collected; final_end_ts locks the declared test so UI polling cannot extend it opportunistically
confidence_backend_recalibration: backend/model revision is part of the evaluation epoch key; changing backend or revision requires a new calibration epoch
confidence_abstain: insufficient independent evidence keeps Candidate in Shadow/fallback; one-sided OFF evidence never qualifies ON
teaching_history: Correct chart uses recorded effective runtime Desired from decision_history/generation decision history. Current-policy replay is not presented as historical Desired; downtime and missing observations render as gaps.
teach_desired_history: effective observed post-teaching/post-experiment runtime Desired; bounded freshness; pending in-memory Live decision records are included before SQLite flush
teach_rl: observed labels -> exact parent snapshot Candidate -> class-balanced bounded correction -> offline regression gate -> paired future direct-parent comparison
teach_rl_feature_reselection: Correct does not reselect schema; schema exploration is isolated to Autonomous/Explore child workflows
teach_rl_queue: generation child work uses the shared heavy-job gate; Live remains available while hidden Candidate work runs
wrong_decision: renamed Change decision; immediate contextual behavior correction plus exact-parent child Candidate revision
sensor_tournament: persistent candidate-pool -> context challenger -> future-only prequential validation -> promotion -> probation/rollback
sensor_tournament_promotion: 40+ future samples, 3+ observed days, >=3pp cumulative gain, three consecutive 24h winning windows, 24h cooldown
sensor_tournament_primary_protection: primary replacement requires >7pp gain unless global margin is stricter
sensor_tournament_quality: predictive gain is reliability-adjusted; unavailable sensors are penalized
sensor_tournament_requalification: schema promotion demotes affected Control agent to Shadow and requires fresh qualification
sensor_tournament_probation: previous serialized model/schema preserved; >3pp degradation after minimum paired evidence rolls back automatically
sensor_tournament_simulator: component fixture simulator: A promotes a designed good sensor, B rejects tiny-sample noise sensors, C exercises concept drift; not a product benchmark score
explore: Free Explore and targeted sensor Explore create a direct child generation; targeted sensors are forced only inside that child and Candidate Shadow remains passive.
explore_ownership: physical probes remain owned by the root Live generation through existing Experiments/Executor; Candidate generations never gain physical-control ownership.
fast_light_baseline: current enabled Home Assistant automation first; extra raw sensors enter through Sensor Tournament
fast_light_objective: automation-residual timing in Shadow: confirmed earlier ON and safe earlier OFF are rewarded
fast_light_negative_outcomes: false early ON, premature OFF, false early OFF and quick OFF-to-ON retrigger are penalized
fast_light_tournament_metric: paired normalized timing utility for fast binary power agents; balanced accuracy retained as safety guardrail
fast_light_tournament_safety: block promotion above 10% challenger timing failures or >3pp balanced-accuracy degradation
fast_light_timing_persistence: additive fast_light_timing_metrics table; no existing user tables cleared
agent_candidate_lifecycle: Live -> immutable child Candidate -> offline gate -> observed Shadow -> paired direct-parent A/B -> explicit confirmed atomic Promote -> promoted generation becomes Live in requested Shadow/Control mode and the Candidate card is consumed
agent_candidate_trigger: Autonomous, Correct, Explore and Change decision create child generations; same-parent corrective bursts may coalesce without crossing parent boundaries
agent_candidate_isolation: Candidate surrogates are hidden from normal Live agent enumeration and never enter physical Executor dispatch before Promote
agent_candidate_coalescing: same-parent generation only; genuine feedback during build marks the child dirty/requeues newer evidence before promotion
agent_candidate_feedback_conflicts: latest explicit instruction wins for the same historical instant; stale ancestor feedback cannot mutate a descendant edge
agent_candidate_config_guard: policy-config fingerprints are generation-aware; stale config invalidates evidence and Promote requires current lineage/config consistency
agent_candidate_manual_rebuild: manual Rebuild creates/uses the hidden Candidate and enters the ordinary TrainingQueue full historical rebuild without Teach RL preflight; Live remains available while rebuild progress is reported
agent_candidate_comparison: same future outcome direct-parent-vs-child comparison with persisted exact-context observed predictions
agent_candidate_binary_gate: standard automatic path: at least 40 future outcomes with at least 20 ON and 20 OFF; Candidate may not regress accuracy by more than 3pp
agent_candidate_promotion: atomic transaction; promoted Candidate model/config/generation identity becomes the stable logical Live agent, hidden surrogate storage and active Candidate edge are removed, requested Shadow/Control mode and automation lease ownership are preserved
agent_candidate_discard: discarding a child preserves its parent generation; discard intent survives restart
agent_candidate_rollback: previous Live generation/model/schema and ownership state are retained for rollback/probation recovery
automation_ownership: only Executor performs Home Assistant service dispatch; Control takeover/lease is transactional and Control->Shadow restores only automations disabled by HomeMind
promotion_atomicity: failed Promote rolls back model/config/mode/generation identity and preserves automation ownership; successful Promote never restores automations mid-swap
migration: no destructive migration; existing repeated Candidate display names are normalized at runtime, while Live agents, archive history, observed Desired, Teach labels, feedback, models, benchmarks, lineage, decision history and Tournament state are preserved
acceptance_invariants: only Executor dispatches physical Home Assistant services
Correct does not mutate parent weights
child starts from exact direct-parent snapshot
child comparison uses direct parent only
observed Desired is never invented by policy replay
Promote is atomic and generation identity is preserved
successful Promote consumes the Candidate edge/surrogate and leaves one active logical Live agent
visible Candidate generation restarts at Gen 1 after Promote without reusing internal generation IDs
automation ownership is preserved through Promote and Control-to-Shadow
binary Correct does not interpret error-only labels as the natural ON/OFF prior
every usable user-marked Correct point is a hard fit target; stability anchors cannot veto it individually
anticipation_simulator: component fixture simulator with intentionally permissive setup; mandatory regression smoke but never used as F24 product benchmark evidence
fast_light_timing_simulator: component fixture simulator for automation-relative ON lead/OFF saved-time rewards plus false/premature penalties; not a product benchmark score
candidate_correct_hard_constraints: every usable user-marked Correct point must match its explicit Desired after bounded repair or standard offline promotion is blocked with Correct did not satisfy all marked corrections
correct_chart_navigation: click inspects; horizontal pointer drag selects and zooms the chosen time range; mouse wheel zooms around cursor; +/- and previous/next controls remain available
